title: Massachusetts Child and Family Tax Credit
condition: Massachusetts resident filing a state tax return; $440 per eligible individual for tax year 2024 and later

title: Massachusetts Paid Family and Medical Leave
condition: worked in Massachusetts and paid into the leave program; up to 12 weeks to bond with a child, finished before the child's first birthday

title: New York Paid Family Leave
condition: worked in New York and covered by Paid Family Leave; up to 12 weeks of job-protected leave in 2026

title: California Paid Family Leave
condition: worked in California and paid into State Disability Insurance; up to 8 weeks of paid leave in a 12-month period
